settings.title: Cookie Policy
settings.policy_content:
Grey Exim uses cookies and similar technologies on www.greyexim.com to operate our Website and provide ecommerce functionality.

This Cookie Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small data files stored on or accessed through your browser or device.

They may help a Website remember information such as shopping-cart contents, login status, privacy choices, location, market, preferences and Website activity.

Similar technologies may include pixels, tags, local storage and related technologies.

2. Strictly Necessary Cookies

These technologies are required for essential Website functions such as Website operation, security, shopping cart, checkout, customer accounts, authentication, fraud prevention, privacy preferences and localization.

Strictly necessary technologies may remain active because the Website may not function correctly without them.

3. Preferences and Functional Cookies

These technologies may help remember optional settings such as language, country, currency, customer preferences and other Website functionality.

4. Analytics and Performance Cookies

Where enabled, analytics technologies may help us understand Website visits, pages viewed, products viewed, navigation, Website performance and general customer interactions.

Where applicable law requires consent, these technologies will be used according to your choices.

5. Marketing and Advertising Cookies

Where enabled, marketing technologies may help measure advertising performance, understand campaign engagement, measure conversions, support personalization and provide more relevant marketing.

Where consent is required, these technologies will only be used according to your preferences.

6. Third-Party Technologies

Third-party apps or service providers integrated with our Website may use cookies or similar technologies.

The technologies used may change as we add, remove or modify Website services.

7. Your Cookie Choices

Where available, you may choose:

Accept All

Reject Non-Essential

Manage Preferences

Rejecting optional cookies should not prevent essential ecommerce functionality from working.

8. Changing Your Preferences

You may revisit Cookie Settings to change your choices where that functionality is available.

You may also manage cookies through your browser settings.

Blocking all cookies may affect the Website, shopping cart, account or checkout.

9. Cookie Duration

Some cookies remain only for a browsing session.

Other cookies may remain for longer periods depending on their function and configuration.

Cookie durations may change when our Website or service providers update their technologies.

10. International Visitors

Privacy and cookie requirements may differ between countries.

Where applicable law requires prior consent for non-essential technologies, appropriate consent controls may be provided.

Continuing to browse will not by itself be treated as consent where affirmative consent is legally required.

11. Changes to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy when our Website, technologies or privacy practices change.

12. Contact Us
